Name: core_i.id_stage_i.deassert_we
Attack Scenarios: A transient fault on core_i.id_stage_i.deassert_we during legal execution can corrupt, suppress, or mis-time the protected primary asset.
Justification: The CSR-write suppression control directly forces operations to READ; a fault can create or suppress an internal CSR write.

Name: core_i.data_misaligned

Attack Scenarios: A transient fault on core_i.data_misaligned during legal execution can corrupt, suppress, or mis-time the protected primary asset.
Justification: The misalignment exception suppresses or redirects writeback; a fault can therefore create or remove an internal CSR write.
